newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads-Canada storms back.
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads-Canada storms back.

text.p: Australian bonds underperformed against their North American partners within the dollar bloc, particularly Canada, which bounced back on Thursday amid a rebound in the Canadian dollar.
Local bonds reversed an initial spread narrowing against the U.S. as yields drifted higher going into the weekend in generally slow activity.

However, it did outperform New Zealand debt, which was spooked by comments by N.Z. Treasurer Winston Peters, saying that the markets were overly optimistic on fiscal forecasts suggesting that budget surpluses would be smaller than previously signalled.
It was also seen as a sign that the government bond tender programme would be larger than it was last year.
The N.Z. budget is next Thursday, while the RBNZ's monetary policy statement is on Friday.
